title: The 3 Best Sous Vide Machines for Meal Prep
h1: The 3 Best Sous Vide Machines for Meal Prep
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for sous vide machines for meal prep, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at sous vide machines for meal prep using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Anova Precision Cooker 3.0, 1100W WiFi Sous Vide
products.blurb: Key specs: 1100W heating element, 8L/min flow rate, Clamps to stockpots up to 8 gallons.
strengths: Highest flow rate in this list, keeping a fully loaded stockpot of bagged protein evenly heated
App-saved presets make repeating the same weekly batch a one-tap operation
1100W recovers fastest when several pounds of cold protein go in at once
limitations: Large stockpot plus circulator plus rack takes real counter and storage space
WiFi dependency for presets is a minor inconvenience if your network is unreliable
features: Clamps to stockpots up to 8 gallons
WiFi app with saved cook presets

products.name: KitchenBoss Sous Vide Cooker G321, 1100W
products.blurb: Key specs: 1100W brushless DC motor, Built-in TFT display with preset recipes, IPX7 waterproof rating.
strengths: 1100W performance at roughly a third of Anova's price
Built-in TFT display with recipe presets removes the need for an app during batch cooks
Brushless motor is noticeably quieter running for hours during a big prep session
limitations: Smaller brand with less long-term reliability track record than Anova or Breville
Fewer total ratings than the market leaders
No dual-band WiFi or remote monitoring like the Anova app offers
features: Built-in TFT display with preset recipes

products.name: Instant Pot Accu Slim Sous Vide Immersion Circulator, 800W
products.blurb: Key specs: 800W heating element, Clamps to 6 or 8-quart Instant Pot inner pot, Touchscreen digital display.
strengths: Clamps directly onto an Instant Pot inner pot you likely already own, no separate stockpot needed
Touchscreen is fully functional without an app, useful if you prep away from WiFi
limitations: 800W recovers more slowly than 1100W units when a full pot of cold protein goes in
6 to 8-quart capacity caps batch size lower than a full stockpot setup
No app for saving and repeating weekly presets
features: Clamps to 6 or 8-quart Instant Pot inner pot

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
